title: #054. DJ Setlist Sequencing
subtitle: Order all N tracks into a smooth cycle starting and ending at the opener/encore using Miller-Tucker-Zemlin subtour elimination.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { setlist, totalCost }.
judge.m1: setlist[{p0}] = {p1} must be an integer track index in [0, {p2}].
judge.m2: Track {p0} appears more than once in setlist (subtour or incomplete set detected).
judge.m3: setlist must start at opener track 0 (received setlist[0] = {p0}).
judge.m4: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match computed cycle transition cost ({p1}).
judge.m5: Valid full-setlist cycle, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
